comment: Copyright holder lines for crates that ship no licence file in the crate
source. The generator reports such crates under NOT RESOLVED LOCALLY;
an entry here gives their holders so the notice travels with the binary
instead of the gap staying open.
- holders must be verbatim lines from an authoritative source (the crate's
own files, or the upstream licence file), never paraphrased or guessed;
- 'source' says exactly where each line was read from;
- keyed by crate name; 'version_seen' records the packaged version the
lines were read from, so drift is visible to a human reviewer.

holders: Copyright (c) 2019 Cloudflare, Inc. All rights reserved.
boringtun.source: copyright header carried in the crate's own source files (allowed_ips.rs, api.rs, dev_lock.rs, drop_privileges.rs, epoll.rs, errors.rs and the rest), boringtun 0.7.1 as packaged on crates.io
